prompt_text:
严格参考输入的冻结生产母图；同一张脸、同一头盔和红色冠饰、同一铁灰与青铜甲胄、同一罗马裙甲、同一材质配色、人体比例、姿态与朝右方向。仅允许 REMOVE / INPAINT / COMPLETE；严禁 REDESIGN / RESTYLE。透明背景，无新增对象，无文字，无投影。输出为原始 1024×1536 画布，人物每个原有地标坐标不变，不移动、不缩放、不裁切。输入二是区域参考：白色允许编辑，黑色必须保留。它不是输出内容。未遮挡像素必须尽可能逐像素保持。

只移除大型红色弧形罗马盾牌，补全其后方原本被挡住的持盾侧上臂、前臂、手腕、手掌、胸腹甲边缘、裙甲与必要的腿部轮廓。当前盾牌位于画布右侧 x700–998, y418–1282。持盾手在 x731,y823 附近：仅补全缺失手指/拳头，保持现有握持姿势、腕甲和可见手指。盾牌后方大部分是透明背景，不要填成人体或新增腿。不要修改现有短剑或暗红披风。
model_note: Backend model not exposed by tool; not asserted to be Image 2.5.
mask_enforcement: Deterministic composite after reference-guided image edit; raw output retained.
matte_review_note: Traced raw silhouette with pale-neutral checker fringe excluded using verified local color contrast; true source alpha preserved outside allowed region.
actual_tool_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target, the FROZEN approved Roman guard rig master. Image 2 is a binary region guide only: white means editable, black protected, not output artwork. Only REMOVE the large red Roman shield at the right of image 1 and COMPLETE the tiny amount of hand/forearm or armor actually occluded behind it. Keep the shield-holding fist at exactly its current position near (731,823) on the 1024x1536 canvas: preserve visible fingers and bracer, complete the hidden fingers plausibly. Most of the shield region covers empty space, which must become genuinely transparent. Do not extend the body into the shield's former silhouette. Keep both existing legs. Keep EVERYTHING outside the white region EXACTLY unchanged: same face, expression, head, helmet, red crest, gray/bronze armor, shoulder armor, proportions, pose, skirt, sword, cape, legs, sandals, materials, colors, hand-painted semi-realistic cartoon style. Same rightward facing. No REDESIGN, no RESTYLE, no full character regeneration, no new limb or weapon. Canvas must stay 1024x1536, no scaling, translation or crop. Output a single full-canvas RGBA image with true transparent background, not black or checkerboard. Do not include the mask. Destination project is D:/Wanjie/documents/uhhj; tool may save its output to its normal location, which will be copied into the project.
